description: This file contains test cases for training object detection models using the ImageAI library. It sets up datasets, configures training parameters for YOLOv3 and Tiny YOLOv3 models, and verifies that training outputs are generated correctly.

methods.name: delete_cache
methods.description: Deletes specified directories if they exist, used to clear previous training data.

methods.name: test_yolov3_training
methods.description: Tests training of YOLOv3 model with optional transfer learning.

methods.name: test_tiny_yolov3_training
methods.description: Tests training of Tiny YOLOv3 model with optional transfer learning.
